source.scope_note: This receipt is a bounded non-overlapping history/mechanism shard, not the complete Project-Frankenstein manifest and not Level-0 completion.

deep_source_units.focus: Global Workspace Bus, AST/HOT/Active-Inference upgrades, multi-turn and long-term memory
5-hour idle audit, 19 failures/fixes, legacy entity removal
Titan->LCME retrieval redesign, HNSW, cold-start gates, reported P@5 improvement
SOMA adaptive-LoRA training pipeline, deploy safety gates, rollback
goal-driven autonomous Project Engine, world model, checkpointing, tiered routing
current LCME orchestration and mature-Hippocampus fallback semantics
current multi-signal retrieval, cold-start negative-result guard, chat-noise exclusion

material_findings.mechanism: FRANK already implemented a multi-timescale cognitive-state architecture with Thalamus sensory gating, NAc reward channels, ACC conflict signals, Amygdala salience/threat signals and E-PQ state coupling.
material_findings.implication: Current FRANK/Harness work should preserve behavioral contracts and failure lessons rather than redesign these semantics from zero.

material_findings.mechanism: A Global Workspace Bus plus attention-schema/metacognitive/prediction components and explicit multi-turn context existed historically; later audits show that nominal coupling was often insufficient without causal-path validation.
material_findings.implication: Current GWT acceptance must test broadcast uptake/effect/re-entry rather than count modules or bus messages.

material_findings.mechanism: LCME current head retains tri-hybrid persistent memory and mature-neural fallback: Hippocampus is used only when ready/mature; conventional retrieval remains authoritative fallback.
material_findings.implication: UnifiedDB/ClayGraph should inherit proven hybrid retrieval/fallback lessons while testing whether logical unification can preserve exact state/provenance.

material_findings.mechanism: Repository history reports retrieval P@5 improvement from 0.40 to 1.00 after deleting 7,213 entity vectors, filtering stopwords, relevance-dominant scoring and cold-start gating; current retrieval source explicitly documents an immature Neural Cortex failure from P@5 1.0 to 0.08.
material_findings.implication: Neural retrieval additions require maturity gates and differential benchmarks against simpler baselines; learned weighting must not be assumed superior.

material_findings.mechanism: SOMA implemented adaptive LoRA training with conversation scoring, snapshots, EMA blending, drift/similarity/NaN deploy gates and rollback. History reports a full CPU cycle in 18.7 minutes on 104 scored/80 qualified conversations.
material_findings.implication: Final Clay-native training need not start from a blank MLOps design; safety/rollback/probe concepts are reusable but must be revalidated for the final model and Clay representation.

material_findings.mechanism: Project Engine v3 already implemented persistent goals, world-model graph, policy engine, tool-outcome learning, action chaining, heartbeat scheduling and checkpoint recovery; history reports a 39s autonomy cycle with zero Claude tokens and a five-step 331s autonomous chain.
material_findings.implication: Harness/FRANK autonomy and recovery can reuse tested orchestration patterns conceptually, but unrestricted system-access/security choices are not automatically reusable.

negative_results.result: AURA queue reached 79% drop rate under drop-newest behavior.
NAc habituation semantics were inverted; 9/14 channels were dead.
Thalamus gain and relay paths were decoupled; 91% of Amygdala signals were suppressed.
E-PQ autonomy was effectively frozen with observed range 0.012.
Dream consolidation was effectively nonfunctional and only one session completed; memory consolidation produced zero useful output.
negative_results.fix: cooldown/idle detection plus keyword extraction and FTS boost

negative_results.result: Immature neural retrieval weights can destroy retrieval quality; current source records P@5 1.0 -> 0.08 during cold start.
negative_results.fix: Neural Cortex and Hippocampus maturity gates before neural path use

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Hybrid persistent retrieval architecture, mature-neural fallback and a concrete learned-ranking failure mode.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Current ClayGraph/UnifiedDB differential benchmark shows these retrieval/fallback lessons do not transfer or are dominated by a simpler/current alternative.

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Implemented cognitive-state coupling plus unusually valuable causal failure atlas from prolonged idle audit.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Current FRANK contract no longer contains analogous channels/couplings or harness lesions show historical failure modes are structurally irrelevant.

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Existing adaptive-LoRA lifecycle with scoring, probes, safety gates, snapshots, GGUF export and rollback.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Final Clay-native model/toolchain makes historical LoRA/export/safety pipeline incompatible or new held-out experiments show no useful transfer.

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Goal/world-model/checkpoint/heartbeat/action-chain orchestration patterns with repository-reported autonomous executions.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Harness implementation shows these orchestration patterns conflict with current Clay authority/state contracts or add more complexity than they remove.

branch_feedback.frank: Preserve historical coupling semantics only where current contract still maps them; import the causal failure atlas aggressively.
branch_feedback.gwt: Historical workspace/bus presence is insufficient evidence; convert queue/gain/relay failures into mandatory lesion/uptake/re-entry tests.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Import LCME hybrid retrieval baselines and cold-start failure as differential benchmark anchors.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Use LCME/SQLite/WAL/FTS/vector history as prior art, not as proof that one physical DB is optimal.
branch_feedback.harness: Encode PF-NEG-001..006 as regression/lesion scenarios where interfaces still exist.
branch_feedback.claycode: Preserve state/coupling contracts; do not hard-code historical module placement as language semantics.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: Historical multi-timescale coupling provides implementation ancestry, not evidence for hyperposition claims by itself.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Treat historical consciousness/GWT labels as functional architecture observations only; do not promote to phenomenal claims.
branch_feedback.clay: Use history as earned substrate and failure memory; current Clay-native implementation still needs fresh executable proof.

completion.next_high_information_action: Continue Project-Frankenstein manifest/history sharding in parallel; obtain chunked/range-capable access or split Drive archive below connector limit without weakening exact coverage.
